id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the [Ld2410](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2410/) component to set.

*See also: [LD2410 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2410#bluetooth_passwordset-action)*

password.docs:
**string**: The password to set. Case sensitive. Must be exactly 6 characters long. Default password is `HiLink`.

*See also: [LD2410 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2410#bluetooth_passwordset-action)*

set.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for setting the bluetooth password.
